items.element_details_zh: 一张密集的涂鸦插画，充满各种卡通风格的黑色线条绘制的图像。这些元素以随机和重复的方式排列，营造出一种混乱但充满活力的氛围。 角色具有简单的线条，圆润的轮廓和各种表情，展现出天真和幽默感。 构图是紧凑的，没有明显的留白。 整个图像只有黑白两色，对比鲜明，线条粗细一致，风格统一。 照明均匀，没有阴影，呈现出一种平面的视觉效果。 整体风格是卡通、涂鸦，带有童趣和创意。 营造出一种随意而又充满想象力的感觉。
items.element_details_en: A dense doodle illustration filled with various cartoon-style black line-drawn images. These elements are arranged randomly and repetitively, creating a chaotic yet vibrant atmosphere. Characters have simple lines, rounded outlines, and various expressions, showing innocence and humor. The composition is compact with no obvious white space. The entire image uses only black and white, with sharp contrast, consistent line thickness, and unified style. Lighting is even with no shadows, presenting a flat visual effect. The overall style is cartoon, doodle, with childlike fun and creativity, creating a casual yet imaginative feeling.
